services.name: Bayous and Byways
services.desc: Discover Louisiana’s Bayous And Byways. This trip is similar to hour popular 2hr Manchac magic Kayak Tour but it allows guests wanting to spend more time on the water to get to further reaches of the swamp. We will have the time to take some of our longer more detailed paddle routes and even get to stop at scenic Lake Maurepas and other scenic swamp locations. After 2-4 hours of paddling we will cap off the trip with a stop at a local eatery for cuisine from the swamp regions. We will then stop at Oak Alley, Whitney, Evergreen, or many other scenic Louisiana Bayou And Byways • Half Day Adventure • Discover Another Side Of Louisiana

services.name: New Orleans Birding Tour
services.desc: Join an experienced birder and photographer for a half day guided trip to the Louisiana Marsh and swamp under an hour from downtown New Orleans. We will travel by motor boat out into the estuary to search for wading birds, coastal sea birds, and smaller migratory birds that frequent the ecosystems of Louisiana. This trip generally starts with an early morning sunrise launch or mid afternoon start leading up to sunset. Wether you are an avid birder or an experienced bird photographer this is a great half day trip while visiting the New Orleans A Bird Watching And Photography Tour!

quotes.text: What a great experience! The tour was so peaceful and majestic. We got to take part in something most Louisiana visitors never get to see. The guides were great guys who made the trip so easy and fun. They went beyond our expectation with helping with the gear and guiding the tour. I will definitely be back for round two!

Josh showed us a side of New Orleans we never expected. He was so knowledgable about the natural habitat and patient ( I am a beginner kayaker). We even saw an alligator!!! Highly recommended to round out the bustle of New Orleans with the surprising serenity that surrounds it.

I've done about five or six swamp tours since i've moved to LA but this was definitely the best, the guy leading was friendly and informative and I saw so much more wildlife than I ever saw on those loud motorboats.
Very knowledgeable and helpful guide. The trip was peaceful and the kayaking simple. The variety of birds was amazing.
